name: Stasis Euro
oneLiner: EURS is STASIS Malta's euro stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against euro deposits at licensed EU institutions including central-bank accounts.
collateral: 100% liquid euro balances held at licensed European financial institutions (EXT LTD, XNT LTD, UAB NexPay), including Central Bank accounts
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through STSS (Malta) Limited; users send EURS to the treasury wallet, euros are transferred from a segregated bank account, and redeemed tokens are frozen or burned

mintAuthority.summary: EURS is issued by STSS (Malta) Limited / STASIS on Ethereum (primary), Polygon, and Stellar. The Ethereum contract's owner slot holds a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (7/3 multisig, no modules/guard) and the issuer slot holds an EOA. Stellar issuer GC5FGD… uses a 5-signer multisig with threshold 3/3/3.

controls.label: STASIS issuer EOA (direct mint/freeze authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295020, storage slot 3 of 0xdb25f211ab05b1c97d595516f45794528a807ad8 contains address 0x70250fcfef983c9b912c8eefb7021b4b7bae836e; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). In the EURSToken contract layout (owner=slot2, issuer=slot3, totalSupply=slot4), slot3 is the issuer address which holds mint/freeze authority in the issuer-operated model. Follow-up 2026-07-20: EURSToken storage slot 3 reads owner = 0x70250fcfef983c9b912c8eefb7021b4b7bae836e (eth_getCode: no bytecode — EOA). setOwner/setDelegate are owner-gated per the verified EURSToken source.

controls.label: STASIS owner Safe (setOwner / admin authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295020, storage slot 2 of 0xdb25f211ab05b1c97d595516f45794528a807ad8 contains 0x1bee4f735062cd00841d6997964f187f5f5f5ac9 (the contract's owner). masterCopy() on that address = 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552 (Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 non-L2); threshold() = 3; getOwners() returned 7 addresses; getModules() = 0; guard slot = 0x0. Slot4 totalSupply = 12412594000 (= 124,125,940 EURS at 2 decimals, confirmed match). Follow-up 2026-07-20: EURSToken storage slot 2 reads delegate = 0x1bee4f735062cd00841d6997964f187f5f5f5ac9, a GnosisSafeProxy (blockscout-verified) with getThreshold()=3 and 7 owners (getOwners()); mastercopy 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552. Delegated EURS execution (mint/burn/freeze) routes through this Safe.

controls.label: Stellar issuer account multisig
controls.evidence: Stellar issuer GC5FGCDEOGOGSNWCCNKS3OMEVDHTE3Q5A5FEQWQKV3AXA7N6KDQ2CUZJ confirmed via Horizon API: 5 active signers (weight 1 each) plus master key (weight 0), thresholds all set to 3 — equivalent to a 5/3 multisig. Signers: GAOHTWU…, GAYMJ7M…, GAZQ6UE…, GC4RTEX…, GD4ZFKF….

review.evidence: Verified at Ethereum block 25295020. EURSToken (non-proxy) at 0xdb25f211ab05b1c97d595516f45794528a807ad8: owner (slot2) = Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (7/3, no modules, no guard); issuer (slot3) = EOA 0x70250fcfef. totalSupply confirmed via slot4. Polygon contract (0xe111178a) has different storage layout; Ethereum is the primary verified deployment. Stellar issuer GC5FGD… confirmed as 5/3 multisig via Horizon API. STASIS advertises quarterly and annual BDO Malta work, but the latest public independent reserve procedures report is dated August 1, 2024; the latest issuer page entry is only a December 12, 2025 account statement. Challenge searches found no 2025 or 2026 independent supply-to-reserve reconciliation, so the stale BDO cadence is not treated as current and reconciliation is unknown. The MFSA registry search did not produce a stable exact issuer authorization for EURS/STSS, and no bank, trust, EMI, or equivalent prudential charter was verified; supervision is none.
